title: Chapter 113 — The Operations-Fluent Professional
intro: The fluency assembled and the bridge to leadership.

sections.title: Operations Fluency Is a Career Accelerator
sections.content:
The salesperson who understands operations is the one who gets promoted. They can manage a floor, coordinate deliveries, handle returns, read a P&L, and lead a team — because they understand the entire business, not just the sales process.

Operations fluency is the bridge between being a great salesperson and being a great leader. Everything in this volume prepares you for that crossing.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating operations fluency, ask:

Does the salesperson understand inventory, delivery, returns, margins, and scheduling?
Can they manage the operational side of the business — not just the sales side?
Are they building the skills that prepare them for leadership?
